title: Mannar comme interface transdétroit
purpose: Make the fort-network economy tangible without promoting one field panel into an island-wide cause.
payoff: Return to Jaffna seeing the north-west as a corridor rather than a terminal periphery.

placement.section_anchor: Jaffna oblige à retourner la carte

content.takeaway: Mannar shows the north-west as an Indian Ocean/Palk interface.
content.body_markdown: Perles, éléphants, choya, travail et navigation relient Mannar au détroit et aux réseaux indiens ; l’exemple rend visible une interface que la perspective colombo-centrique périphérise.
